backlog.spec: Add a second loss term that predicts the token at position t+2 from the final hidden state, using a separate small linear head (dim -> vocab) or reusing lm_head with a learned dim x dim projection first. backlog.spec: Replace the linear warmdown with a cosine shape: over the final WARMDOWN_RATIO (set to 0.6) of training progress, lr multiplier = FINAL + (1-FINAL)*0.5*(1+cos(pi*t)) where t goes 0 to 1 and FINAL_LR_FRAC = 0.05. backlog.spec: For the first 25 percent of the time budget, train on sequences truncated to half length (take the first half of each batch row, with the batch row count doubled so the tokens per step stay constant, or simply keep rows and drop the second half and accept fewer tokens per step). Then switch to the full length. Short sequences are cheaper in attention and early training does not need long context. Be sure that torch.compile recompiles only once, and mark the shape dynamic if needed.
backlog.title: Sequence-length curriculum

backlog.spec: Maintain an exponential moving average of model parameters with decay 0.999 updated every step after the first 50 percent of training. Before the final evaluation, copy the EMA weights into the model. Do not touch the evaluation call itself. Only swap the weights just before it. Use torch._foreach ops to keep it cheap, and keep the code short.
